rows.why: Consecutive realized losses in the journal vs the breaker threshold of 3.

rows.name: Drawdown risk freeze
rows.why: Regime is measured on the Active Trading NAV equity curve. Above 8% drawdown, the risk multiplier goes to 0.00x.

rows.name: Adding to losing legacy position
rows.limit: No new risk on losing legacy names
rows.why: A position that is Legacy / Unclassified and unrealized-negative may be trimmed or stopped out, never added to.

rows.name: Minimum reward:risk
rows.why: Planned reward ÷ planned loss vs the 2.00R minimum this mandate requires.

rows.name: Near concentration limit
rows.why: Exposure within 10% of the single-name concentration limit deserves a second look before sizing up further.

rows.name: Stop width
rows.why: Unusually wide stops raise unit risk and can indicate the setup does not fit this instrument's volatility.
